summary: Open sensor/manual event without other fields
observed_behavior: Manual sensorless event opens; source is manual – no sensor; simulated duplicate stop reuses the event. A genuinely new stop after first good part is also reused while the original record awaits closure.
status_basis: Nominal FR behavior observed; event lifecycle loses a resumed-then-stopped interval (F-03).
test_evidence: UI-09; UI-18; UI-19; existing REQ-01 test; PROBE-03

observed_behavior: Running duration advances by 30 minutes; confirmation freezes it at 30; early/future timestamps are refused. A timestamp during the recorded isolation interval is accepted once release exists at the current time.
status_basis: Arithmetic passes; accepted chronology can contradict the release record (F-02), and a second interval can be lost (F-03).
test_evidence: UI-07; UI-13–16; UI-19; existing REQ-02 test; PROBE-02/03

summary: Complete coded closure and missing-item messages
observed_behavior: Missing reason and first good part are enumerated; fixed-list codes are enforced; a valid timed and coded record closes. Existing tests also cover early code retention and release-dependent closure.
status_basis: Fully satisfied for the evaluated coded-closure rule as written. This is not a claim that the incomplete safety policy in REQ-06/09 is sufficient.
test_evidence: UI-10; UI-17; existing REQ-03 and REQ-06/09 tests

summary: Attributable open-repair notes and optional photo
observed_behavior: Empty entry is refused; tests and next action save with author/time/shift and appear in the timeline. Photo-only domain state passes an existing unit test; actual browser file selection/display was not tested.
status_basis: Text workflow validated. Photo browser selection was blocked by extension file-access permission (UI-31); human SC-004 timing remains unvalidated. Neither is an application test failure.
test_evidence: UI-11; UI-12; UI-31 (environment blocked); existing REQ-04/05 test; source inspection
findings: Validation remaining: photo browser path; SC-004

summary: Machine summary, history and open-repair list
observed_behavior: Next action, previous tests, contributors, last-entry identity/shift and acknowledgment state are visible; closed records show verification state and history. The Open repairs filter was exercised: only Press 12 and Molder 8 remained; All machines restored all six assets.
status_basis: Summary and filter behavior observed; independent incoming-person comprehension SC-005 remains unvalidated.
test_evidence: UI-12; UI-16; UI-20–22; UI-30; UI-32/33; existing REQ-04/05 test; source inspection

summary: Energy-source locks and documented release gate
observed_behavior: No unrelated field blocks lock capture; active lock blocks production/release; Technician release is refused; cross-person removal and supervisor authorization are stamped. A removed lock that was never verified still permits release, and earlier production timestamps remain possible.
status_basis: Written role and applied-lock guards work; the selected hazardous-energy goal is only partly supported by the current completeness and chronology rules (F-01/F-02).
test_evidence: UI-01; UI-03–08; UI-20; existing REQ-06 tests; PROBE-01/02/06

observed_behavior: 06:29 is Awaiting acknowledgment; 06:30 is Not acknowledged; verified active-lock acknowledgment records incoming user and applier; Operator role is refused. A current-shift note changes an overdue handover to Current shift with no acknowledgment.
status_basis: Nominal boundaries/roles work; explicit acknowledgment obligation is ambiguous after current-shift edits (F-04).

observed_behavior: 06:10 first good part waits until 22:00; a late-coded matching pre-deadline stop reopens/links the repair. Reclassifying the ongoing stop as a different category yields Verified – ran full Swing shift despite no subsequent first good part.
status_basis: Literal same-reason/time algorithm behaves as specified, but it cannot establish the claimed full-shift operation or durable fix (F-05).

observed_behavior: Unverified active lock blocks handover and names the source; verified active lock can be handed over; closure waits for removed locks and release. Once an unverified lock is removed, its missing verification is no longer a gate.
status_basis: FR-020(a)/(b) work as narrowly written; the broader complete-record goal excludes required historical fields from its closure check (F-01).
test_evidence: UI-02; UI-06–08; UI-20; existing REQ-06/09 and REQ-09 tests; PROBE-01
